page.layout: One page of text: a table of names with years in a right column (1585 to 1591), each group ruled off. Descriptive notes stand in the left margin, beside the groups.

l.note: Clades Buxumana in Frisia occid. vincentib. Hispanicis.
Age: Gron. ordinib. confederatis tributarius factus.
Casicella emotillanu, Xeidanum [?] Soltcamp, ab Ordinib. foederatis duce Guilhelmo Coir. Nassovio Hispanici adempta.
Emotillam Hispanici recuperant, Ager omnis in ora a milite ordinum affligitur.
Groninga ab Ordinib. confoederatis, ducib. Nassaviis obsidione nequicquam tentata: Delfsila, Vpslachtum, Emotilla, captae.

page.notes: The small marks at the lower left corner, which look like a gathering signature, are too faint to read reliably and are left out. The left-margin notes are transcribed from the scan with several doubtful words ("Casicella", "Xeidanum", "Soltcamp", "Emotillam") that should be checked against the original. Years are the printed figures at the right of each group. The first and last rules of the table have no running head.
